verses.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.pt: Ora nós, que somos fortes, devemos suportar as fraquezas dos fracos, e nào agradar a nós mesmos.
verses.en_web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.en_bbe: We who are strong have to be a support to the feeble, and not give pleasure to ourselves.

verses.en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.pt: Portanto cada um de nós agrade ao seu próximo, visando o que é bom para edificação.
verses.en_web: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
verses.en_bbe: Let every one of us give pleasure to his neighbour for his good, to make him strong.

verses.en: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
verses.pt: Porque também Cristo não se agradou a si mesmo, mas como está escrito: Sobre mim caíram as injúrias dos que te injuriavam.
verses.en_web: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
verses.en_bbe: For Christ did not give pleasure to himself, but, as it is said, The bitter words of those who were angry with you came on me.

verses.en: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.pt: Porquanto, tudo que dantes foi escrito, para nosso ensino foi escrito, para que, pela constância e pela consolação provenientes das Escrituras, tenhamos esperança.
verses.en_web: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.en_bbe: Now those things which were put down in writing before our time were for our learning, so that through quiet waiting and through the comfort of the holy Writings we might have hope.

verses.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: Ora, o Deus de constância e de consolação vos dê o mesmo sentimento uns para com os outros, segundo Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: Now may the God who gives comfort and strength in waiting make you of the same mind with one another in harmony with Christ Jesus:

verses.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Para que unânimes, e a uma boca, glorifiqueis ao Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: So that with one mouth you may give glory to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
verses.pt: Portanto recebei-vos uns aos outros, como também Cristo nos recebeu, para glória de Deus.
verses.en_web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
verses.en_bbe: So then, take one another to your hearts, as Christ took us, to the glory of God.

verses.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.pt: Digo pois que Cristo foi feito ministro da circuncisão, por causa da verdade de Deus, para confirmar as promessas feitas aos pais;
verses.en_web: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
verses.en_bbe: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision to give effect to the undertakings given by God to the fathers,

verses.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
verses.pt: e para que os gentios glorifiquem a Deus pela sua misericórdia, como está escrito: Portanto eu te louvarei entre os gentios, e cantarei ao teu nome.
verses.en_web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.”
verses.en_bbe: And so that the Gentiles might give glory to God for his mercy; as it is said, For this reason I will give praise to you among the Gentiles, and I will make a song to your name.

verses.en: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.pt: E outra vez diz: Alegrai-vos, gentios, juntamente com o povo.
verses.en_web: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
verses.en_bbe: And again he says, Take part, you Gentiles, in the joy of his people.

verses.en: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
verses.pt: E ainda: Louvai ao Senhor, todos os gentios, e louvem-no, todos os povos.
verses.en_web: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
verses.en_bbe: And again, Give praise to the Lord, all you Gentiles; and let all the nations give praise to him.

verses.en: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.pt: E outra vez, diz também Isaías: Haverá a raiz de Jessé, aquele que se levanta para reger os gentios; nele os gentios esperarão.
verses.en_web: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
verses.en_bbe: And again Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, and he who comes to be the ruler over the Gentiles; in him will the Gentiles put their hope.

verses.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Ora, o Deus de esperança vos encha de todo o gozo e paz na vossa fé, para que abundeis na esperança pelo poder do Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Now may the God of hope make you full of joy and peace through faith, so that all hope may be yours in the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.pt: Eu, da minha parte, irmãos meus, estou persuadido a vosso respeito, que vós já estais cheios de bondade, cheios de todo o conhecimento e capazes, vós mesmos, de admoestar-vos uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
verses.en_bbe: And I myself am certain of you, brothers, that you are full of what is good, complete in all knowledge, able to give direction to one another.

verses.en: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
verses.pt: Mas em parte vos escrevo mais ousadamente, como para vos trazer outra vez isto à memória, por causa da graça que por Deus me foi dada,
verses.en_web: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
verses.en_bbe: But I have, in some measure, less fear in writing to you to put these things before you again, because of the grace which was given to me by God,

verses.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: para ser ministro de Cristo Jesus entre os gentios, ministrando o evangelho de Deus, para que sejam aceitáveis os gentios como oferta, santificada pelo Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: To be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, doing the work of a priest in the good news of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be pleasing to God, being made holy by the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
verses.pt: Tenho, portanto, motivo para me gloriar em Cristo Jesus, nas coisas concernentes a Deus;
verses.en_web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
verses.en_bbe: So I have pride in Christ Jesus in the things which are God's.

verses.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
verses.pt: porque não ousarei falar de coisa alguma senão daquilo que Cristo por meu intermédio tem feito, para obediência da parte dos gentios, por palavra e por obras,
verses.en_web: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
verses.en_bbe: And I will keep myself from talking of anything but those things which Christ has done by me to put the Gentiles under his rule in word and in act,

verses.en: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.pt: pelo poder de sinais e prodígios, no poder do Espírito Santo; de modo que desde Jerusalém e arredores, até a Ilíria, tenho divulgado o evangelho de Cristo;
verses.en_web: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: By signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and round about as far as Illyricum I have given all the good news of Christ;

verses.en: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
verses.pt: deste modo esforçando-me por anunciar o evangelho, não onde Cristo houvera sido nomeado, para não edificar sobre fundamento alheio;
verses.en_web: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
verses.en_bbe: Making it my purpose not to take the good news where Christ was named, so that my work might not be resting on that of others;

verses.en: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.pt: antes, como está escrito: Aqueles a quem não foi anunciado, o verão; e os que não ouviram, entenderão.
verses.en_web: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
verses.en_bbe: But as it is said in the holy Writings, They will see, to whom the news of him had not been given, and those to whose ears it had not come will have knowledge.

verses.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.pt: Pelo que também muitas vezes tenho sido impedido de ir ter convosco;
verses.en_web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
verses.en_bbe: For which reason I was frequently kept from coming to you:

verses.en: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.pt: mas agora, não tendo mais o que me detenha nestas regiões, e tendo já há muitos anos grande desejo de ir visitar-vos,
verses.en_web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
verses.en_bbe: But now, having no longer any place in these parts and having had for a number of years a great desire to come to you,

verses.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.pt: eu o farei quando for à Espanha; pois espero ver-vos de passagem e por vós ser encaminhado para lá, depois de ter gozado um pouco da vossa companhia.
verses.en_web: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
verses.en_bbe: Whenever I go to Spain (for it is my hope to see you on my way, and to be sent on there by you, if first I may in some measure have been comforted by your company)--

verses.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.pt: Mas agora vou a Jerusalém para ministrar aos santos.
verses.en_web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
verses.en_bbe: But now I go to Jerusalem, taking help for the saints.

verses.en: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Porque pareceu bem à Macedônia e à Acaia levantar uma oferta fraternal para os pobres dentre os santos que estão em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: For it has been the good pleasure of those of Macedonia and Achaia to send a certain amount of money for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem.

verses.en: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.pt: Isto pois lhes pareceu bem, como devedores que são para com eles. Porque, se os gentios foram participantes das bênçãos espirituais dos judeus, devem também servir a estes com as materiais.
verses.en_web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, it has been their good pleasure; and they are in their debt. For if the Gentiles have had a part in the things of the Spirit which were theirs, it is right for them, in the same way, to give them help in the things of the flesh.

verses.en: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.pt: Tendo, pois, concluído isto, e havendo-lhes consignado este fruto, de lá, passando por vós, irei à Espanha.
verses.en_web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
verses.en_bbe: So when I have done this, and have given them this fruit of love, I will go on by you into Spain.

verses.en: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.pt: E bem sei que, quando for visitar-vos, chegarei na plenitude da bênção de Cristo.
verses.en_web: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And I am certain that when I come, I will be full of the blessing of Christ.

verses.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.pt: Rogo-vos, irmãos, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo e pelo amor do Espírito, que luteis juntamente comigo nas vossas orações por mim a Deus,
verses.en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
verses.en_bbe: Now I make request to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you will be working together with me in your prayers to God for me;

verses.en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.pt: para que eu seja livre dos rebeldes que estão na Judéia, e que este meu ministério em Jerusalém seja aceitável aos santos;
verses.en_web: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
verses.en_bbe: So that I may be kept safe from those in Judaea who have not put themselves under the rule of God, and that the help which I am taking for Jerusalem may be pleasing to the saints;

verses.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
verses.pt: a fim de que, pela vontade de Deus, eu chegue até vós com alegria, e possa entre vós recobrar as forças.
verses.en_web: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may come to you in joy by the good pleasure of God, and have rest with you.

verses.en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: E o Deus de paz seja com todos vós. Amém.
verses.en_web: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Now may the God of peace be with you all. So be it.
